code.notes: MIT covers repository code.

data.notes: LBNL FCU sample derivative is CC BY 4.0; Open-Meteo weather data/API use is described as non-commercial in the repository. Verify current terms before commercial use or redistribution.

sources.sourceData: LBNL fan-coil-unit FDD dataset sample, Open-Meteo weather API data, and a synthetic hydronic-circuit simulator.
sources.contentsReviewed: README.md, LICENSE, pyproject.toml, detect.py, evaluate.py, sim.py, test_detect.py, test_lbnl.py, robustness.json and fetch_lbnl.py. Rule set covers low delta-T, valve leakage/stuck, overflow at part load, sensor offset/swap and unbalanced zone; uses a 28-day baseline and 3-of-5 persistence.
sources.equipmentCoverage: Hydronic heating/cooling circuits, fan-coil units, pumps, control valves, sensors and zones.
sources.qualityNotes: Repository reports 40/40 simulated nominal faults and 32/40 hard-scenario recall. LBNL valve check is 14/14, but the README says the same LBNL sample was used to revise/tune the rule; metrics are author-reported and not independently reproduced. No real-building validation.
sources.dataLeakage: LBNL sample was used for rule tuning and then evaluation, so 14/14 is not an independent holdout. Split future evaluation by building/system/run; simulator results do not prove field generalization.
sources.dependencies: Python >=3.10; NumPy, pandas and matplotlib; optional Open-Meteo fetch.
sources.androidWorkerCompatibility: Python data pipeline is not Worker-native. A small rule subset could be ported only after independent validation and equipment-specific thresholds.
sources.reuseConditions: MIT code with attribution; LBNL-derived sample under CC BY 4.0 with attribution; Open-Meteo free API usage is stated as non-commercial in the repository, so do not use that feed commercially without checking current terms.
sources.potentialUse: Reference for baseline-relative HVAC diagnostics and persistence testing; do not copy its thresholds as universal maintenance limits.

sources.sourceData: Simulink/Simscape main aircraft fuel-pump model; synthetic time-series generated by MATLAB script; raw CSV payload not present in the Git tree.
sources.contentsReviewed: README.md, LICENSE, mainFuelPumpV4.slx, generateRuns_with_identifiers.m, .gitattributes and time_series_csv LFS pointer files. Script describes 1,000 runs of 30 seconds at 200 Hz with injected pump/valve/sensor faults.
sources.equipmentCoverage: Aircraft main fuel-pump/fuel-delivery circuit; not a general industrial centrifugal pump.
sources.qualityNotes: Simulation-only; requires MATLAB/Simulink/Simscape Fluids R2025a. README estimates about 12 GB of generated CSV, but raw data is not committed. No field validation.
sources.dataLeakage: If generated data is used, split by complete run and parameter seed. Random time windows from the same simulation run could leak the same model trajectory/signature.
sources.dependencies: MATLAB R2025a, Simulink and Simscape Fluids; large generated CSVs.
sources.androidWorkerCompatibility: Not Android/Worker compatible; only a licensed MATLAB environment can generate the dataset.
sources.reuseConditions: MIT for repository code/model; no separate license for generated CSVs verified. Do not distribute generated data until its terms are clarified.
sources.potentialUse: Study synthetic pump fault injection and test harness ideas only; do not transfer aircraft-system assumptions to centrifugal pumps.

code.notes: Do not copy repository code, notebooks or model artifacts without permission.

data.notes: No raw MIMII audio or model weights are included; the upstream MIMII public 1.0 dataset is CC BY-SA 4.0, which does not license this repository's code.

sources.sourceData: MIMII public 1.0 pump audio benchmark (Zenodo 3384388, CC BY-SA 4.0); no raw data or weights included in this repository.
sources.contentsReviewed: README.md, COPYRIGHT.md, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, v0.7/v0.8 model cards, run manifests, metrics and requirements.txt. v0.7 reports clip-level split AUC 0.9926; v0.8 reports unit-holdout AUC 0.6757.
sources.equipmentCoverage: Pump acoustic anomaly detection using MIMII recordings; binary normal/anomalous, not root-cause diagnosis.
sources.qualityNotes: Author-reported metrics only; not independently reproduced. Manifests record dirty worktrees and local-only split/checkpoint artifacts; weights and split membership are absent, limiting reproducibility.
sources.dataLeakage: v0.7 clip split may place recordings from the same machine unit in train and test; leakage is a risk, not proven. v0.8 holds out one unit only; no external-site validation.
sources.dependencies: Python 3.13, PyTorch 2.10 and CUDA 12.8 in the reviewed manifest; not a lightweight runtime stack.
sources.androidWorkerCompatibility: No model weights; training requires PyTorch/CUDA. Not Android/Worker runtime compatible.
sources.reuseConditions: Do not copy code/model artifacts without permission. MIMII CC BY-SA 4.0 applies only to the upstream dataset, not to this repository's code or derived model artifacts.
sources.potentialUse: Use as a model-evaluation lesson: report unit-held-out results and distinguish anomaly detection from causal diagnosis.
